goal_context.evidence: Connects to completed Story 2.1, states user value, and scopes the requested additions.

technical_guidance.evidence: Existing files, routes, entities, test suites, and metrics are identified. The checkout has no architecture documents; this is noted in Dev Notes.

references.evidence: References the existing story, build configuration, source tree, and tests; no architecture/PRD shards are available in the checkout.

self_containment.evidence: Acceptance criteria cover API behavior, roles, frontend flows, persistence, quality thresholds, and handoff.

testing.evidence: Requires existing regression suites, focused tests, PostgreSQL/Testcontainers, SPA smoke validation, and exact JaCoCo thresholds.

coderabbit.evidence: API, database, security, and frontend scope has matching agents, gates, self-healing, and focus areas.

sequencing.evidence: Baseline tests precede changes; schema/service work precedes SPA integration and final validation.

security.evidence: API protection, ownership/resource-role validation, JWT claims, and backend authority are explicit.

risks.description: No migration runner dependency/configuration is present in the checkout; implementation must ensure migrations execute before Hibernate schema validation.
risks.mitigation: AC1 requires a clean PostgreSQL bootstrap and ddl-auto=validate test; consult the applicable dependency approval rule if adding a dependency.

risks.description: Architecture documents configured by core-config.yaml are absent.
risks.mitigation: Use the existing code patterns and story/source references; do not extend requirements beyond the supplied scope.

recommendation: Ready for implementation; verify migration execution and schema preservation in PostgreSQL before proceeding to dependent API/UI flows.
